typography_source.reason: Figma connector reports that the connected user lacks the required access.

usage_contract.mascot: Use an exported mascot as an identity reference. Animation may change pose or expression but must preserve the pin silhouette, yellow palette, face, and recognizability.
usage_contract.product_ui: Use approved exported screens or current captured UI. Do not ask a generative model to redraw readable application UI or product text.
usage_contract.transition: Travel footage should transition into a semantically matching product screen, preserving destination, action, or map continuity.
usage_contract.text: On-screen product text must remain legible and must be evaluated separately from general visual similarity.
